question.text: <math> <mrow> <msup> <mtext mathvariant="italic">EDTA</mtext> <mrow> <mn>4</mn> <mo>-</mo> </mrow> </msup> </mrow> </math> is ethylenediaminetetraacetate ion. The total number of N - Co - O bond angles in <math> <mrow> <msup> <mrow> <mfenced close="]" open="[" separators=","> <mrow> <mtext mathvariant="italic">Co</mtext> <mfenced close=")" open="(" separators=","> <mrow> <mtext mathvariant="italic">EDTA</mtext> </mrow> </mfenced> </mrow> </mfenced> </mrow> <mrow> <mn>1</mn> <mo>-</mo> </mrow> </msup> </mrow> </math> complex ion is

solution.text:
EDTA4-  is a hexadentate ligand containing four negative charges on its corner oxygen atoms as follows :

 

Being a hexadentate ligand, it forms a ring like structure through chelation.

 

 

 

The central metal ion Co is in the centre, coordinated to the two N atoms and the four O- ions through chelation. Now, if we observe, we see that each N atom forms four N - Co - O bonds with the four O- ions. Therefore, two N atoms will form 2 × 4 = 8  N - Co - O bonds in the complex structure of [Co(EDTA)]1-. Each bond will have a certain bond angle. Hence, it can be concluded that the total number of N - Co - O bond angles in the complex ion is 8.
